title: "furniture" is developer slang that reached the UI ("new operations and furniture join it", "is setup furniture, not a model")

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:low
labels.description: Mechanical, one file, no new logic (issue-worker-low)

body:
Reported by a user in #866 ("Note the 'furniture join'. Seems like AI is hallucinating"), raised by the maintainer, investigated and filed by an agent. Same kind of problem as #876 ("work offset word").

## What "furniture" means
It is this codebase's internal nickname for the things a setup owns that are neither the part's models nor operations: the setup's stock, its WCS (work offset), its fixtures, machine, post and tool list. The source comments use it everywhere (`crates/app/src/setup.rs`, `schema.rs`, `model.rs`: "setup furniture, never a browser row"; `setup::is_furniture_shape`). It is a fair metaphor in comments. It is not a machining term, and no user can know it.

## Where it reached the user (strings, not comments)
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/setup_pages.rs:148` - the radio button on a setup's page: **"Active setup - new operations and furniture join it"** (since d017b74b, 2026-11-09). This is the "furniture join" of #866. It means: new operations, and the stock, work offset and fixtures you create, will belong to this setup.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:794` - "The Stock and Work-offset pages edit the active setup's furniture."
- Refusals a user or an MCP client can see: `commands/update_model.rs:81` and `commands/repair_model.rs:47` "'{name}' is setup furniture, not a model"; `commands/fixture.rs:91` "'{name}' is setup furniture or CAM data, not a model to mark"; `commands/setup.rs:95` "... that separator belongs to setup furniture"; `commands/setup.rs:109` "'{name}' is reserved for setup furniture".
- `crates/app/src/mcp/model_tools.rs:36` - the `repair_model` tool description (check it and the other MCP descriptions and script API messages for the word).

## Fix
Say what the thing is, in plain words (maintainer, 2026-11-11, on #876: the wording must be English people grasp):
- the radio: e.g. "Active setup - new operations, stock, work offset and fixtures are added to it";
- the hint: e.g. "The Stock and Work-offset pages edit the active setup.";
- the refusals: name the kind, e.g. "'Setup1/Stock' is a setup's stock, not a model" / "is part of a setup (its stock, work offset or fixtures), not a model"; "'{name}' is a name reserved for a setup's stock and work offsets".
Sweep every user-facing string, MCP description and script message for "furniture" (and list what was checked in the PR). Comments and identifiers may keep the word. Update the tests that pin these strings; no snapshot PNG changes; no behaviour change.

Overlap: the contributor's draft PR #875 (for #866) says it rewords 'furniture' on the path it touches. Check what it changed before starting, and do not duplicate it - this issue covers the rest.

Done means: no user-facing string, MCP tool description or refusal contains "furniture"; each says plainly what it refers to; the pinning tests are updated.
